summary.text: Steve Swiontek is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 10 (Fargo), serving since 2023 (he also served from 1977 to 1984). His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Appropriations, where he is vice chair of the Education and Environment Division.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Swiontek is the retired chair, president and CEO of Gate City Bank and its current board chair, with a BS in economics and military science from NDSU.
His biography lists service on the Fargo Board of Education from 1985 to 1991 and the Cass County Electric board from 1996 to 2017, and a 2019 Legacy Leader Award from the FMWF Chamber.
In the interim he chairs the Water Topics Overview Committee.
His biography lists him as married to Mary Anne, with two children and three grandchildren.
